items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Sincerely yours, W. Johnston. President. Mm-hmm. That's W. A. Johnston. President. ... [INTERVIEWEE] He's still, he's still President.

ctx.x: I got this here. The Illinois Central Railroad, it says here. February 7, 1956. Dear Sonny, I have a report which informs me that you have retired. Now that your working days are over, I suspect that you will find getting, I suspect this will find you getting a good rest for yourself. You were on the job a long time and worked hard at it. I just wanted you to know of our appreciation for your service with the Illinois Central and to wish you a long and happy retirement. Sincerely yours, W. Johnston. President.…
